capabilities: sync new Readwise highlights into vault notes
update existing notes with new highlights
customize note headers and highlight formatting via Nunjucks templates
map Readwise author values via authors.json
schedule syncs on startup or on an interval
extras: Warns that the API token is stored in localStorage and may conflict if the same vault is open in two windows; notes a limitation of pulling only the most recent 1000 highlights, and links a roadmap and GitHub issues for pending work.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to import and keep updated the highlights collected in a Readwise account.

relations.evidence: Both plugins exist for different use cases, so please read below to determine which best suits your needs.

summary: Readwise sync plugin that pulls new Readwise highlights into your vault as notes, with customizable header and highlight templating.
